answer: The marble register is checked at draw time, gale lists the eligible set, and grove seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 62 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 62 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. A 330 account operation therefore ties up 1 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
